question: Should OpenClaw permanently sponsor this Discord-only progress feature with seven configuration fields and new public channel lifecycle and delivery-context contracts, or require a narrower internal contract first?
rationale: Code review can assess implementation correctness, but only maintainers can decide whether the feature's Discord value justifies expanding permanent core, configuration, and Plugin SDK surfaces.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Retain the Discord behavior while replacing or reducing public lifecycle and configuration additions with a generic internal seam and smaller policy surface.

options.title: Sponsor the current surface
options.body: Accept the seven settings and public lifecycle contracts as intentional long-term APIs, with their compatibility and upgrade obligations.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR if Discord-only progress does not justify the additional core and SDK coupling.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public contract
recommendation.body: Retain the Discord behavior while replacing or reducing public lifecycle and configuration additions with a generic internal seam and smaller policy surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on channel and plugin API boundaries rather than a mechanical defect in the Discord implementation.
